nodes.name: Call Primary
nodes.notes: Pure mechanism. Posts request_body (primary model already set) to endpoint_url. onError=continueErrorOutput: a non-2xx/network error routes to Prep Fallback Body (out[1]); a 2xx routes to Assess Primary (out[0]) which still re-checks the optional success_path payload predicate (a 2xx with an empty payload is a failure too).

nodes.name: Assess Primary
nodes.notes: Decide if the primary 2xx response is genuinely usable: 2xx + body, and if success_path is set, that deep-path is non-empty (handles the image 'Docling gotcha' 2xx-with-no-payload). Emits ok flag + the normalized result shape.

nodes.name: Prep Fallback Body
nodes.notes: Reached when the primary failed (HTTP/network error out[1], or 2xx-but-not-ok). Builds the fallback request body by swapping model to fallback_model; an EMPTY fallback_model re-sends the primary model (floor behavior) so the next call fails again and Assess Fallback throws.

nodes.name: Call Fallback
nodes.notes: Same url/headers/cred as primary; body has model swapped to the fallback. onError=continueErrorOutput so both outputs reach Assess Fallback, which throws on a still-bad result -> one CRITICAL on both-down.

nodes.name: Assess Fallback
nodes.notes: Same usability test as Assess Primary. If the fallback is also not usable (HTTP error OR 2xx-empty), THROW -> both-down -> the caller's errorWorkflow fires exactly one CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Return
nodes.notes: Sole branch-free leaf -> deterministic sub-workflow return. Fed by Primary OK?-true OR Assess Fallback (exactly one fires per run). Emits the seam contract.

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { fell_back: !!j.fell_back, model_used: j.model_used, body: j.body, headers: j.headers } }];
